sections.title: Coming home is very hard
sections.text: To bring a robot back, a rocket needs a lot of extra fuel. That makes a mission much bigger and costs much more money.

sections.title: Some jobs are one-way
sections.text: Some robots were built to stay where they landed, or to fly away forever. Their job was to explore and send news home, not to come back.

sections.title: Some robots went quiet
sections.text: Dust, cold nights or getting stuck can stop a robot. When it does not answer any more, the team cannot fix it from far away.

sections.title: Some are still talking
sections.text: A few explorers are still sending messages to Earth right now. They are left out there on purpose, to keep learning.
